study.authorization: explicit authorization required for each pair; no automatic admission of remaining pairs
study.repeatPolicy: no automatic repeats, replacement samples, or continuation across repaired source identities
study.capSemantics: admission bounds; retain actual in-flight overshoot and all failure costs

validationPolicy.quality: semantic factual correctness separate from delivery; errors continue with actual history
validationPolicy.execution: canonical delivery and exact consumer ACK; inspect authorized tool operations; unknown effects stop
validationPolicy.cost: retain all generations, retries, failures and output; no trajectory equality

historyPolicy: independent arm histories; fixed business questions; own peer replies relayed without editing

native.accounting: Round metrics and durable usage overlap; never add them together. Known totals retain observed failures; missing values remain unknown.

worker-delivery.accounting: Round metrics and durable usage overlap; never add them together. Known totals retain observed failures; missing values remain unknown.

longObservation.interpretation: All observed costs remain visible. Prefix ratios are descriptive only; quality failure is not cured by later success. Token vectors are not bills.

evidenceKind: P122 public projection; original retained privately
